lore.intro:
Records. Aisle 9 is missing.
Aisle 9 is where the missing things go.

radio.text: Ratio: Records stack, one aisle. Grab the incident files and get out.
Ratio: The cores. Bring them— no. Leave them at their posts. They died holding the line so I could seal. Read the manifest, Commando. Say their names back to me. Please.
Ratio: Your depth gauge is counting. You're walking north in a room forty meters long and you've made three hundred. Stop walking north.
Ratio: The registrar's stamp, filed under 'registrar's stamp'. At least the shelving is honest.

Ratio: You walked out of a room that has no end. Remember that, next time something chases you. Core approach is next. The vault, and the sample vessel. The vault predates this station, Commando. We built the Core around a door we could not open.

terminals.text:
SHELF TAG, AISLE 9
Everything filed here is filed here.
Everything filed here is filed here.
Everything filed here is filed here.
[the tag continues for some time]

INCIDENT FILE 0001
First contact was not a signal.
It was an inventory discrepancy.
We had one more room than we built.
We sent Osei to measure it.
It measured back.

CORE RECOVERY MANIFEST
Staff-mind cores, recovered from Records:
  VESALIUS - damaged, held the west ring
  THIBAULT - damaged, held the junction
  OSEI - [NO CORE RECOVERED]
They held the subverted peripherals out of the
core ring so the administrator could seal.
Osei walked into Aisle 9 to buy them the time.
Effects racked below the cores: one records
stamp, registrar's issue. The deep-stack gate
releases on the stamp. Sign it back in after.

INCIDENT FILE 0000
Empty folder. The tab reads 0000.
Someone filed the folder itself as
the incident.
Appendix: one requisition slip,
approved, for 'one additional room'.

VOICE LOG, TRANSCRIBED — OSEI
Going in with the tape measure this time, not
the laser. If the laser's reading wrong the tape
will tell me different, and if the tape agrees
with the laser I'll believe the laser about
everything else too.
Ratio wanted someone with steady hands for this.
I have steady hands. I also have a tape measure.
Belt, suspenders.

REQUISITION SLIP — APPROVED
Item: one (1) additional room. Justification
field: blank.
Approving signature: illegible scan, three
characters resolve, the rest is scanner noise.
The three that resolve are not initials MIRIAD
uses for anyone on this posting.
Cost center charged: Site One, pre-existing
allocation. Site One had no pre-existing
allocation. The charge went through anyway.

gold.gate_prompt: STACK GATE SEALED - REGISTRAR'S STAMP REQUIRED
